en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a large industrial building, likely a sawmill, with a tall smokestack emitting smoke. The building stands in a snowy or frosty landscape. There are railroad tracks curving in the foreground, and a railcar or cart standing next to the building. Handwritten notes appear on the right edge of the image, and printed text is present at the bottom.
